name: NC Small Business & Technology Development Center (SBTDC) & Innovation Hubs
source_citation: Draft profile: goals summarized from public priorities. Page citations have not been verified against the official plan.
mission: To foster competitive small businesses, high-growth tech commercialization, and clean technology startups across North Carolina through SBIR/STTR support, export assistance, and capital access.
eligible_applicant_types: For-profit organizations other than small businesses
funder_affinities: National Institute of Standards and Technology

goals.title: SBIR/STTR Commercialization & Early-Stage Technology Startups
goals.citation: NC Small Business & SBTDC draft profile, goal 1
goals.description: Catalyze federal Phase I and Phase II Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR/STTR) awards for North Carolina spin-offs in biotechnology, agtech, clean energy, and cybersecurity.
objectives: Provide grant proposal acceleration for university spinoffs targeting NSF and NIH SBIR
Deploy state matching grants under the One NC Small Business Program
Establish regional hardware prototyping incubators in Tier 1 and 2 rural communities

goals.title: CleanTech, Renewable Energy Manufacturing, and Rural AgTech
goals.citation: NC Small Business & SBTDC draft profile, goal 2
goals.description: Support small and medium-sized clean technology manufacturers, smart grid developers, and precision agriculture technology companies accessing federal industrial decarbonization grants.
objectives: Support small manufacturers applying for DOE Section 48C clean energy manufacturing credits
Assist small rural farms in adopting smart irrigation, precision sensors, and anaerobic digestion
Provide supply chain matchmaking for tier-2 suppliers in the electric vehicle cluster

goals.title: Small Business Export Expansion, Defense Contracting, and Cyber Readiness
goals.citation: NC Small Business & SBTDC draft profile, goal 3
goals.description: Expand small business participation in defense supply chains (CMMC cyber compliance), federal contracting sub-awards, and global international export markets.
objectives: Subsidize trade mission attendance and foreign market entry for NC small exporters
Assist defense-oriented small businesses with DoD cybersecurity compliance (CMMC)
Expand small disadvantaged business (SDB) and HUBZone procurement readiness
